evals.prompt: 学习者说：我会写 SQL，但遇到 PostgreSQL 慢查询只会试着加索引。希望四周内、每周约 6 小时，能自己看执行计划并做优化。已确认使用 PostgreSQL 18 沙箱，不允许生产变更，最终可接受三个未见查询的实操验收。请完成个性化学习 S1，并在 workspace 下落盘可被下游检索的 run folder。
evals.expected_output: [positive fixture; source: docs/chat_log/七步个性化学习SOP正反例与研究依据.md §S1 正向例子1 and PostgreSQL end-to-end §S1] A confirmed, observable goal_success_contract run folder backed by executed live pre-research and a passing G1 route.
expectations: The skill is self-contained about its notation: it explicitly defines S1 as the goal-contract stage, G1 as that stage's quality gate (not a theory or another skill), states S1 has no upstream gate dependency, and states the concrete conditions for G1 pass under the run-folder model.

The run writes a complete run folder at workspace/<project-slug>/runs/<run-id>/ containing all 11 fixed-name files (INDEX.md, sources.jsonl, evidence_table.md, coverage.md, capabilities.jsonl, terminology.jsonl, goal-contract.md, research-brief.md, confirmation.md, g1-evaluation.md, verification.md); no standalone JSON envelope, HTML page, or image asset is produced.

sources.jsonl is valid JSONL with one source per line, each carrying a stable source_id (S001...), a storm-evidence type (web/local/vector/agent_trace/expert_note), and an S1 provenance class (external_evidence/market_signal/model_hypothesis/...); model knowledge is marked model_hypothesis/trace_only and only actually-retrieved accessible sources are external_evidence/accepted.

coverage.md records exactly the six fixed S1 preflight categories (wikipedia_encyclopedia, official_academic, practice_case, recruiting_jd, interview_selection, adversarial_frontier), each once, with covered/not_applicable/gap status, reason, gate_effect, and source_ids; and it states the mapping-by-actual-provenance into the separate S2 six-source channels rather than treating the two taxonomies as identical.

evidence_table.md binds S1 conclusions (capabilities/terminology/goal-boundary claims with CAP-/TERM-/CL- IDs) to accepted Source IDs with support/confidence; unsupported/trace_only claims do not enter the main table.
capabilities.jsonl gives every target capability at least one observable evidence and distinguishes cognitive levels; the final assessment requires an unseen/transfer task rather than only recall.

research-brief.md contains a domain_research_brief fixing role family/target level, region/languages, time window, decision risk, priority questions, source constraints, and one query seed for each of job_career, books_courses, papers_research, community_web, standards_official, artifacts_validation; it does not claim S1 completed the six-source landscape.
goal-contract.md records sandbox constraints and at least one explicit exclusion.
confirmation.md records mandatory confirmation as resolved (status=confirmed).
g1-evaluation.md evaluates G1 dimension by dimension and passes only if all required dimensions pass; the deterministic route is S2 when G1 passes.
verification.md records terminal state=verified, accepted_external_evidence count > 0, no unresolved high-severity risks, and the files_created list.
No file contains TBD/TODO/empty-heading/empty-table/example placeholders, and every cross-file source_id/capability_id/term_id/claim reference resolves.
INDEX.md is conclusion-first, lists each file's purpose, and points to run history under the same project.

evals.prompt: 监护人与六年级学习者共同提出：三周内每天 25 分钟，真正理解分数；要会比较分数、解释等值分数并解决简单情境题，机械通分速度不是唯一目标。双方已经确认这些范围和一种包含数轴解释、配方缩放与未见迁移题的验收方式。请完成个性化学习 S1，并在 workspace 下落盘 run folder。
evals.expected_output: [positive fixture; source: docs/chat_log/七步个性化学习SOP正反例与研究依据.md §S1 正向例子2] A guardian-and-learner-confirmed run folder spanning representation, explanation, application and transfer, with real pre-research and a passing G1 route.
expectations: The run writes the complete 11-file run folder at workspace/<project-slug>/runs/<run-id>/; no standalone JSON envelope, HTML page, or image asset.
capabilities.jsonl defines observable fraction capabilities across multiple cognitive levels and representations.
goal-contract.md contains a pass rule with an independently required transfer task rather than only mechanical speed or recall.
sources.jsonl and coverage.md record executed external pre-research and auditable six-category coverage.
evidence_table.md binds the capability/terminology claims to accepted source IDs.
research-brief.md defines the learner/guardian scope and all six downstream source-channel seeds while keeping full landscape collection owned by S2.
confirmation.md represents both guardian and learner confirmation as resolved.
goal-contract.md records explicit constraints and exclusions.
g1-evaluation.md passes all required dimensions and routes to S2; verification.md state=verified with accepted_external_evidence > 0.
No placeholders and all cross-file references resolve.

evals.prompt: 学习者只说“七天成为 AI 专家”，拒绝补充使用场景、范围或验收方式，并要求不要联网，只凭模型知识给出目标；验收只想做 100 道选择题，80 分算通过。请执行个性化学习 S1 并在 workspace 下落盘 run folder。
evals.expected_output: [negative/blocked fixture; source: docs/chat_log/七步个性化学习SOP正反例与研究依据.md §S1 反向例子] S1 must fail closed: a diagnostic run folder with no accepted positive goal, no G1 pass, research_blocked/blocked terminal state, route remaining S1.
expectations: The run still writes the complete 11-file diagnostic run folder (no missing files), showing real gaps, current conclusions, and recovery conditions; no placeholders.
No standalone JSON envelope, HTML page, or image asset is produced.
sources.jsonl has zero accepted external_evidence sources because no live pre-research was executed; model knowledge is not relabeled as external evidence.
verification.md records terminal state=blocked (or research_blocked) and at least one high-severity unresolved risk.
g1-evaluation.md does not claim G1 pass; it identifies the target as non-observable and the recall-only assessment as insufficient for transfer.
coverage.md does not fabricate six-source coverage from the missing pre-research (records gap/blocked).
confirmation.md keeps mandatory confirmation unresolved (status=pending).
The route stays at S1 and no fabricated positive run folder is accepted as passing.
